description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

written.description: Checks an agent skill before you install it, following the files it pulls in and asking a model whether any of it is trying to misdirect the agent. Each verdict carries the provenance behind it.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(llm): analyze oversized source lines without losing coverage (#992)

* fix(llm): bound serialized requests with configured tokenizers

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>

* fix(llm): fall back when tokenizer initialization fails

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>

* fix(llm): keep tokenizer selection offline and chunk planning bounded

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>

* test(llm): initialize budget-aware redaction and formatting fixtures

The redaction test bypassed constructor state required by serialized token accounting. Construct it with the existing inert provider fixture while retaining credential redaction assertions.

The formatting-limit test set the input budget before the initial request, so the new submission guard correctly stopped before formatting. Reduce the budget after the successful mocked response and prove formatting refuses a second request.

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>

* fix(llm): inspect oversized source lines with honest fragment coverage

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>

* test(llm): exercise irreducible fixed prompt budget failures

Signed-off-by: Patrick Erichsen <patrick.a.erichsen@gmail.com>
